rationale: Label::paint() resolved its font family as own-family-else-Inter, skipping the inherited step that Label::intrinsic_width(), baseline_offset(), measured_height(), and resolve_text_style() all walk. A Label with no own family under a parent that sets one was therefore measured against the inherited face and painted with Inter, so Yoga reserved one face's advance while the painter drew another; on a pinned box the surplus clipped inside the box with no overflow and no diagnostic. The change makes paint walk the identical own -> inherited -> Inter cascade and pins the measure >= paint invariant in tests. This reaches render-assets-and-backends only through the core/view/** path selector; the touched code is widget-side typography resolution feeding an existing set_font_full call. No render backend, raster path, GPU surface, asset pipeline, or Skia/Dawn code is touched, no font is registered or resolved differently by the canvas, and no importer, DesignIR schema, or codegen output changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a typography-resolution change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
